styles.name: title-section

styles.name: code
styles.usage: Technical values: versions, hashes, keys and logs.

radius.note: Containers tighten as they nest (16 → 12 → 8); controls use 10; pills are for avatars and dots.

tokens.name: radius-xs
tokens.usage: Tiny tags and keycaps.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Menu items and icon tiles.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Cards, summaries, banners and tooltips.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Slides, the command palette and toasts.

tokens.name: radius-btn
tokens.usage: Buttons and icon buttons.

tokens.name: radius-input
tokens.usage: Inputs and the search field.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Badges, avatars and dots.

shadow.note: No drop shadows under cards. Only overlays float.

tokens.name: shadow-overlay
tokens.usage: The slide stack, toasts and the command palette over the backdrop.

layout.note: Shell: a grouped side menu (a bottom bar on phones), a 60px top bar, full pages with their own routes, and slides for create and confirm. A token with a phone value switches below the md breakpoint.

tokens.name: layout-menu
tokens.usage: Side menu width. The slide stack starts beside it.

tokens.name: layout-bottombar
tokens.usage: Bottom bar height on phones. The slide stack stops above it.

tokens.name: layout-topbar
tokens.usage: Top bar height.

tokens.name: layout-panel
tokens.usage: Slide width on desktop. Slides are for create and confirm only.

tokens.name: layout-gutter
tokens.usage: Page gutter: the workspace and the top bar.

tokens.name: layout-card
tokens.usage: Padding inside cards and slides, and the inline inset of rows.

tokens.name: layout-block
tokens.usage: Gap between blocks and sibling cards.

control.note: Control heights. Every button in a row shares one height.

tokens.name: control-btn
tokens.usage: Button and icon button height.

tokens.name: control-btn-sm
tokens.usage: Small button height, for rows and compact inputs.

tokens.name: control-input
tokens.usage: Input height.
